title: Andy’s Ancestry
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, Andy claims to be related to Michelle Obama, leading to discussions about family history and ancestry. The characters explore themes of identity, heritage, and the impact of ancestors' actions, with humorous and confrontational moments. Andy also discusses his childhood hardships and the questionable pasts of his ancestors, prompting moral debates among the staff.
